mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_expense_report (report_no, drafter_id, dept_id, title, purpose, total_net, total_vat, total_amount, status_cd, approval_doc_id, reimburse_required_yn, memo, attach_group_id) VALUES (#{reportNo}, #{drafterId}, #{deptId}, #{title}, #{purpose}, COALESCE(#{totalNet}, 0), COALESCE(#{totalVat}, 0), COALESCE(#{totalAmount}, 0), COALESCE(#{statusCd}, 'DRAFT'), #{approvalDocId}, COALESCE(#{reimburseRequiredYn}, 'N'), #{memo}, #{attachGroupId})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_expense_report SET title = #{title}, purpose = #{purpose}, total_net = #{totalNet}, total_vat = #{totalVat}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, reimburse_required_yn = #{reimburseRequiredYn}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE report_id = #{reportId}

UPDATE gw_expense_report SET status_cd = #{statusCd}, reimburse_payment_id = COALESCE(#{reimbursePaymentId}, reimburse_payment_id), reimbursed_at = COALESCE(#{reimbursedAt}, reimbursed_at), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.name AS drafter_name, d.dept_nm FROM gw_expense_report r JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.drafter_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = r.dept_id WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId}
SELECT r.*, u.name AS drafter_name, d.dept_nm FROM gw_expense_report r JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.drafter_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = r.dept_id WHERE r.approval_doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_expense_item (report_id, seq_no, expense_dt, category_cd, account_cd, vendor_nm, vendor_biz_no, linked_vendor_id, net_amount, vat_amount, total_amount, payment_method_cd, card_last4, receipt_type_cd, linked_invoice_id, project_cd, memo, attach_group_id) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{seqNo}, #{expenseDt}, #{categoryCd}, #{accountCd}, #{vendorNm}, #{vendorBizNo}, #{linkedVendorId}, COALESCE(#{netAmount}, 0), COALESCE(#{vatAmount}, 0), COALESCE(#{totalAmount}, 0), #{paymentMethodCd}, #{cardLast4}, COALESCE(#{receiptTypeCd}, 'CARD'), #{linkedInvoiceId}, #{projectCd}, #{memo}, #{attachGroupId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gw_expense_item WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY seq_no

SELECT r.*, u.name AS drafter_name, d.dept_nm FROM gw_expense_report r JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.drafter_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = r.dept_id WHERE r.drafter_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 200
